failure_semantics: Retrieval-layer observations only. A failed probe is not evidence that the source URL is dead, incorrect or editorially invalid: transport failures, bot protection, stale relocations and missing pages are recorded as distinct classes so a reviewer can see exactly what happened without weakening the quotation. Each preflight run additionally produces a fresh read-only classification report of its own.

probe_provenance: Classes recorded from the read-only preflight re-probe executed from GitHub-hosted egress (preflight run 37230337223, 2026-10-04). The restricted sandbox that produced the earlier sweep could not complete TLS handshakes for many hosts; that difference is a retrieval-layer fact and never a judgement about a source. Each preflight re-probes the inventory again and reports every non-retrieved URL with its class and target.
